acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full universal small-ball/density statement for X^T A X with independent original-coordinate densities bounded by 1 and at least three eigenvalues of A of magnitude at least 1; continuity is separate.

first_unresolved_implication: Derive a dimension-free exponential all-order collision bound from only the three-large-eigenvalue spectral condition, without selecting a dimension-degrading fixed physical block and without pointwise oscillatory decay.
